core_obligations: Criterion setup (proof lines 1605-1610): the three conditions of the Artin axioms lemma correspond to the diagonal, RS-star, and limits lemmas.

Obstruction theory (proof lines 1612-1637): O_x(M) = Ext^2 with obstruction class from the deformation theory lemma; axioms hold except functoriality, which reduces by the footnote to fixed A and follows from the functoriality lemma; tangent identification from the same lemma.

Product conditions (proof lines 1639-1663): the compute-ext lemma gives the perfect K with isomorphisms for i = 1, 2; product-commutation of cohomology holds for pseudo-coherent K by the More on Algebra characterization, giving T_x(prod) = prod T_x and O_x(prod) = prod O_x.
proof_roadmap: Map the three criterion conditions to established lemmas (proof lines 1605-1610).
Construct the obstruction theory and verify its axioms, reducing functoriality to fixed A (proof lines 1612-1637).
Verify the product conditions via the perfect object K and the pseudo-coherence characterization (proof lines 1639-1663).
